Local source: doc/src/contributing/pull-request-guidelines.rst
Keep all section headings below. -->

#### References to other Issues or PRs
None

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed
This PR fixes some typos and grammar mistakes in Development Workflow Process.
( `doc/src/contributing/new-contributors-guide/workflow-process.md` )  :-

- "intended for people are already familiar" -> "intended for people **who** are already familiar"
- "It's only function is to distinguish" -> "**Its** only function is to distinguish"
- "need to include imports for every function used define any symbols that are used" -> "need to include imports for every function used **and** define any symbols
 that are used"
- "These do indicate to reviewers" -> "These do **not** indicate to reviewers"
- "which always recorded the name" -> "which always **records** the name"

#### Other comments
First contribution

#### AI Generation Disclosure
Used Gemini 3.6 Flash to make sure of the errors and error corrections

#### Release Notes

<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->
NO ENTRY
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->
